labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Request for a wider type on Table title, i.e. new behaviour in the API.

items.body:
Feature requests for Rich need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened. Please start there if you want this change considered.

A closely related request, #4171, was closed as not planned on 2026-06-18. The Discussions post can explain what a wider title type would add that the `Table.grid` approach you mentioned cannot.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
